description.value: Clover Sushi is a Japanese-focused restaurant in a commercial unit on Admirals Road in the Esquimalt/View Royal area of Greater Victoria, blending traditional sushi techniques with creative rolls, premium sashimi, and a few Korean-inspired dishes like bibimbap. The restaurant offers both a dine-in experience in what it describes as an elegant yet comfortable setting, and a pickup option through their mobile ordering service.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 8m; rack (5 spaces) at 48m; rack at 70m; rack at 75m; rack at 80m; rack at 96m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business name, address (1505 Admirals Rd #111 Victoria, BC V9A 2P8), and phone (250-382-3990), matching OSM tags. The site explicitly states 'Dine In & Pick Up' confirming takeout availability. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: Website footer credits 'luckyhan.ca' rather than cloversushi.ca, suggesting a shared or white-label website platform — the site content appears genuine but ownership attribution is opaque.
Menu includes bibimbap, a Korean dish, despite the OSM cuisine tag being 'japanese' — minor inconsistency.
Website displays two different hours blocks with differing information, suggesting the page content may not be fully maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating restaurant with confirmed contact details, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit or direct contact is needed to assess cyclist-friendliness before listing.
